as_told.title: Eric Bard's own account of challenging the phenomenon and the first screenshot

plain: At Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property long known for reports of strange events, a team member named Erik Bard says he was sitting alone in the control room when he said out loud, "okay this is stupid," and then: "If you got something you want to show me, show me. If you got something you want to tell me, tell me." Bard tells Michels that the very first screenshot he took afterwards showed letters on the screen pulled together into the words "I living." The ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal, tells the same story on the show and adds that the letters were taken "completely out of sequence" and joined "in a millisecond," with no explanation; if true, it would mean something at the ranch answered him.
